data.long_meaning: Wenona is a name of Native American origin, derived from the Algonquin language. It is believed to mean 'friend' or 'beloved'. The name Wenona carries the meaning “Friend, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wenona usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
